title: MEIKO — As A Fan〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Whew...!
That should be enough practice for today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thank you for letting me practice with you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some of the things we did seemed pretty difficult at first, but it was fun to practice in a different way for a change!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
I had fun as well♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And there's more where that came from. You're always free to join me for another session♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haha... I'd like to, but I'm not sure I'll be able to keep up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, welcome!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good evening, MEIKO, Miku.
Are you two free right now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, we just finished practicing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
There's something I need to tell you both.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Is this about your TV appearance?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
We decided to accept.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You gave this offer quite a lot of thought, so I'm glad you were able to come to a decision.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Congratulations, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I really appreciate you all giving me advice regarding this. What you said made me realize some important things.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As your fan, I want to say, “Don't worry.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Including the hope and warmth you wish to spread to others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And those things mean quite a lot to me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, a TV appearance isn't going to easily change how I feel about all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree...
You girls are who you are. Nothing is going to change that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Once again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for taking my concern seriously and listening to what I had to say.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Miku
rows.Line: You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But we really didn't do all that much other than say what we felt.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's not true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What you said, MEIKO, not only helped me reach a decision in terms of appearing on TV, but it also reminded me of my roots.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your roots...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. The reason I wanted to become an idol in the first place...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remembered the person who made me believe in a better tomorrow. The idol who gave me that hope.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, there's someone who you look up to, like the way Minori looks up to you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's no longer an idol, but she still performs on stage from time to time and spreads cheer to everyone she meets.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. She sounds like a wonderful person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, she is...!
The first time I met her, she was so kind and warm, and made everybody around her smile...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That feeling of warmth in my chest. The way she dazzled everyone. I still remember it all very clearly...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Being reminded of when I met her made me remember the feeling of hope she gave me. The belief that tomorrow will be a better day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Haruka...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You girls put on a successful solo show and have put forth a fantastic goal for yourselves. As a result, you're at a crossroads so to speak.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's not uncommon to lose sight of what means most to you... Why you decided to become an idol in the first place or how you felt back then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, now might not be a bad time to look back on all that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She actually tried doing what I suggested.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hehe. Oh, Haruka. You're such an earnest girl.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I learned from the newspaper that she was still spreading hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: From the newspaper?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I had no idea what she was doing after she'd retired from being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that article showed me how she's still doing her best, and just how powerful the media can be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So that's what helped you reach your decision.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to tell us all of this, Haruka. Rest assured, you all have our support moving forward.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, since we want to see you appear on TV and perform a show at the Dome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. And I'd like it as well if you're all there with us every step of the way as we spread hope to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, we'll be looking forward to your continued support.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Miku
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO, Miku & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.
